Josh, saw IMPLAN launched Forward Linkages and new tariff and price-shock modeling tools.

Josh, quick follow-up for IMPLAN.

When volume spikes, reps spend their day on research, writing, and CRM logging instead of conversations, and ramp time on new hires only stretches it further. Our built-in best practices alone tend to lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change to speed up follow-up across the team.

I pulled a benchmark of how IMPLAN's reply rate likely compares to other B2B data and analytics teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
